scan_linter_check.description:
Flags catch blocks that make failures disappear: empty catch blocks, and catch blocks that never reference the caught error and do not rethrow. The script then carries on as if nothing failed, and nobody can tell why data is wrong later.
Replaces the legacy check "Y1- Broad try-catch Wrapping Entire Function Bodies", which measured the size of try blocks in characters; the real risk is the catch that hides the error.
scan_linter_check.name: JS-004: Empty or swallowing catch block
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Handle the error: log it with context (gs.error with the exception and what was being done), rethrow, or return a clear failure. If ignoring it is really intended, say why in a comment and mute this finding.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A catch block is empty, or never uses the caught error and does not rethrow.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: JS-004: Empty or swallowing catch block
